query: Use hyperfine to benchmark whether ripgrep is faster than grep on this corpus: `rg 'TODO' .` vs `grep -r 'TODO' .` across ~3k source files.
Use hyperfine to measure the runtime regression after this refactor — old `./bin/process-v1` vs new `./bin/process-v2` on the same input file.
Use hyperfine to compare these two shell commands' speed with proper statistics, not just one `time` run: `fd -e py .` vs `find . -name '*.py'`.
Use hyperfine to run a CLI benchmark with warmup runs and export JSON for later analysis: `./scripts/build.sh release`.
Use hyperfine to compare `./sort-old data.csv` vs `./sort-new data.csv` — I want mean and stddev.
Use hyperfine to sweep thread counts 1, 2, 4, 8 and report how `./processor --threads {threads} data.bin` scales.
Use hyperfine to time `make -j4` across ten runs and report the median.
Use hyperfine to compare a Python script against a Rust rewrite at the command line: `python3 parse.py input.json` vs `./parse-rs input.json`.
Use hyperfine to measure cold-cache vs warm-cache read time for this file-processing tool: `./indexer scan ./data/`.
Use hyperfine to export a markdown table comparing the runtime of these three CLI tools: `rg pattern .`, `ag pattern .`, `grep -r pattern .`.
Use hyperfine to measure performance regression of a binary between two git commits, with `--prepare` to swap binaries.
Use hyperfine to compare `xz -3 archive.tar` vs `zstd -3 archive.tar` on a 500 MB file with warmup.
Profile a slow function inside a Python program to find the hot loop.
Run cargo bench on this Rust crate's microbenchmarks.
Set up CI for tracking performance over time across PRs.
Measure the peak memory usage of a long-running process.
Trace the syscalls a process makes to debug an EACCES error.
Generate a flamegraph showing where my web server spends its CPU time.
Use pytest-benchmark to time individual functions in my test suite.
Benchmark a single SQL query inside Postgres with EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
